# Master services agreement

Counterparty: Helion Robotics Ltd.
Effective: 12 March 2019
Term: 36 months, then successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 60 days' written notice.
Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM. Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited. That is the same legal entity. Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company
